scope: One unchanged original main with return-only profile; captured matrices/bases are original execution evidence, not a second audit.
limitations: Finite parameter ranges are preserved; unbounded parameter claims need the analytic proof in the body.
Circuit vectors are selected complete basis vectors, not enumeration of all minimal-support circuits.
Static profiles and signed linear identities provide neither ordered-history strategies nor oriented SPE payment certificates.
all_unit checks ranks only; six captures returns only, not the 64 left/right values.
Source requires Python assertions; stale report files cannot certify a failed run.
new_static_checks: fingerprints, JSON/Fraction syntax, array dimensions, captured counts/returned fields, links and receipt only; no rank/nullspace/payoff recalculation
